en: A vintage black and white postcard featuring five photographs of various landmarks in a European city. The central image shows a large cathedral with two towers. Other images display a public square with a domed building, a decorative fountain, an academic building with a flag, and a landscaped park with an ornate urn. Text in Hungarian is present above each image and at the bottom.
